name: Fuyukiku
source:
Likes: Stars, Nights
Dislikes: Traditional customs of the Winter Village
Hobby: Stargazing
Home: Winter Village

Loved by god, but in a shell and forever alone

Son of the Winter Village chieftain who has been chosen for the next chieftain candidate. People worship him because he is believed to be a child that is loved by god, which he simply disregards. His calm nature and soft manner seem amiable, but some say that those qualities are to disguise his true self.

He has made good friends with Kaito, Shiroya, and Ran (his brother), but what is the truth behind?

[From in-game profile]
